title: Vietnam, End to End.
note: Print palette derived 2026-10-14 from the site's «Bốn Bản» identity (poster red + jade + gold on cream, Anton/Source Sans 3/Space Mono). NOT lifted verbatim: the site's #E8331C is a screen red that floods at 40% ink coverage and the #FFBE0B gold is a backlit yellow; both are deepened for cream stock. The book keeps Anton for display (the poster cut IS the site's thesis and it carries Vietnamese diacritics — Hội An, phở — in the same design) but swaps the body to Source Serif 4, a sibling of the site's Source Sans 3 that survives 13px justified over 15k words. Space Mono stays as the apparatus face.

derivation.paper: site --bone #F2EDE1 → #F3EDE0 · a touch warmer; cream reads cooler on a backlit screen
derivation.ink: site --ink #0C0B0A → #16140F · lifted; a near-black that dark closes up on cream
derivation.accent: site --green(primary) #E8331C → #C9321D · deepened and desaturated; poster red floods at ledger-rule coverage
derivation.jade: site --brass(accent) #0E8C70 → #137A64 · deepened one step for hairline rules and the verdict bar
derivation.gilt: site --saffron #FFBE0B → #D9A520 · softened; screen gold is harsh on cream stock, used for the endmark and figure numbers
derivation.line: site --line #D7CFBD → unchanged; warm hairlines already work in print
derivation.muted: site --ink-soft #514B42 → unchanged; caption and label grey

fonts.display_note: the site's poster cut; carries Vietnamese diacritics
fonts.body_note: sibling of the site's Source Sans 3; low-contrast book serif, prints cleanly at 13.4px
fonts.mono_note: the site's utility face; furniture, ledger heads, marks
fonts.local: all faces are local woff2 under build/fonts/ with local-fonts.css — never base64 (bug log #34)
